snippet.description:
Do monster waves really exist? Sponsored by KiwiCo - Use code VERITASIUM at https://kiwico.com/veritasium for 50% off your first monthly crate.

Last year, we launched Elements of Truth on Kickstarter. We’re now in the final stages of production, and Kickstarter rewards are shipping soon. If you missed the campaign, you can now pre-order the retail edition through our new website here - https://ve42.co/YTDEcl  
If you backed us on Kickstarter, don’t worry, your game will ship before any pre-orders are fulfilled.

If you’re looking for a molecular modelling kit, try Snatoms, a kit I invented where the atoms snap together magnetically - https://ve42.co/SnatomsV 

Sign up for the Veritasium newsletter for weekly science updates - https://ve42.co/Newsletter

Join our Patreon for early access to work-in-progress videos and behind-the-scenes extras https://ve42.co/VePatreon 

▀▀▀
00:00 The Draupner Rogue Wave
00:52 MaxWave Satellite Survey
01:53 How Tsunamis Form
03:12 How Wind Builds Waves
06:46 Wave Superposition
11:08 Wave of Translation
16:48 Making a Rogue Wave in the Lab
19:13 How Wave Groups Steal Energy
21:15 How Two Storms Made the Draupner Wave
23:28 Rogue Holes & Optical Rogue Waves 

▀▀▀
Special thanks to the experts and collaborators who made this video possible:
Amin Chabchoub, Ioannis Karmpadakis and Conrad Duncan, and the teams at Imperial College London and the Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology, for their expertise and help with the wave-tank experiments.
Justus Bock, Nils Kerpen, Torsten Schlurmann and Jannik Meyer at the Large Wave Flume (GWK) in Hannover for their help with filming.
Mark McAllister, John Dudley, Jack Keeler, José Carlos Nieto Borge and Utkarsh Jain for helping us with the technical sections.

David Pritchard and Edward Duyker for helping us with the historical sections on John Scott Russell and Dumont d’Urville respectively.

And also shout out to Gaurav who spotted us en-route to the Imperial Hydrodynamics Lab and for our great conversation about hydro and aerodynamics.
▀▀▀
References: https://ve42.co/RogueWaveRefs

▀▀▀
Special thanks to our Patreon supporters:
Adam Foreman, Albert Wenger, Alex Porter, Alexander Tamas, André Powell, Anton Ragin, Balkrishna Heroor, Bertrand Serlet, Blake Byers, Bruce, Bryan Ackermann, Chris Brewer, Data Don, Dave Kircher, David Johnston, David Tseng, EJ Alexandra, Evgeny Skvortsov, Garrett Mueller, Gnare, gpoly, Hayden Christensen, Hong Thai Le, Hybrid Minds, Ibby Hadeed, Jeromy Johnson, Juan Benet, Kelcey Steele, KeyWestr, Kyi, Lee Redden, Marinus Kuivenhoven, Mark Heising, Martin Paull, Meekay, meg noah, Michael Krugman, Orlando Bassotto, Parsee Health, Paul Peijzel, Robson, Sam Lutfi, Shalva Bukia, Sinan Taifour, Sweet_Nemo, Tj Steyn, Ubiquity Ventures, wolfee

▀▀▀
Credits:
Writers: Gabe Strong and Henry van Dyck
Producer and Director: Gabe Strong
Development Producer: Emilia Gyles
Presenters: Henry van Dyck and Emilia Gyles
Editors: Trenton Oliver, Nazim Kadri-Zade, George Reynolds and James Stuart
Additional Editing: Mirza Bajic
Animators: Alex Drakoulis, Domonkos Józsa, Emma Wright, Andrew Neet, Ivy Tello, Rokas Viksraitis and Steve Walker
Illustrator: Jakub Misiek
Camera Operators: Björn Frank, Rob Newman, Gabe Strong, Emilia Gyles and Henry van Dyck
Researchers: Aakash Singh Bagga, Callum Cuttle, Fred Green and Sophia Rose
Production Team: Al Brown, Anna Milkovic, Dom Ford, Glen Griffiths, Jess Bishop-Laggett, Josh Pitt, Justin St-Laurent, Matthew Cavanagh and Peter Nelson
Thumbnail Designers: Abdallah Rabah and Daniel Ellacott
Executive Producers: Henry van Dyck, Emilia Gyles, Casper Mebius and Derek Muller
